source: AI workloads contain temporal locality at many scales: repeated weights across tokens and batch elements, reused matrix tiles inside a kernel, normalization parameters shared across positions, and KV state read across decoding steps. Which level captures that locality depends on the size and timing of the reuse.
zh: AI 工作负载包含多个尺度的时间局部性：跨令牌和批处理元素的重复权重、内核内重用的矩阵图块、跨位置共享的标准化参数以及跨解码步骤的 KV 状态读取。哪个级别捕获该局部性取决于重用的大小和时间。
